payload.name: Use Full Time Range for Month-Bounded Event Queries
payload.description: When a query asks about an event in a named month/year or broad time window, use time_mode range covering the whole window instead of a single point.
content: When a question asks about an event 'in [month] [year]' or another broad time window, set time_mode to 'range' with start and end covering the entire named period; do not use time_mode 'point' anchored to the first day because it can exclude events later in the month.

If the first range search does not surface a matching memory, run one broader retry: keep memory kinds 'event' and 'plan', add question-specific activity and invitee/participant terms, and widen the time window or omit it before concluding no information.
Stop after one or two retries once a memory matching the subject and event is retrieved.

solves: Queries that describe an event by a named month or broad time window often fail when the search anchors time_mode to a single point, excluding memories later in that window. This skill ensures month-bounded queries use a full-range time window and retry before answering no information.
